comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district name signs along the full route (Norman Manley Airport → Palisadoes → Harbour View → Kingston → Spanish Town → Bog Walk gorge → Linstead → Moneague → Faith's Pen → Fern Gully → Ocho Rios). Coordinates are real OSM lat/lon, projected into world space the same way as landmarks.json. radius = trigger distance in compressed-world meters. needs_owner_review: true means the entry was inferred from map data — the owner's lived knowledge is authoritative. Each entry has a stable id from creation (standing rule — future ad/analytics system depends on this).

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Eastern gateway to Kingston, at the end of the Palisadoes strip

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: East Kingston hillside community along Windward Road

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: East Kingston, industrial area along the waterfront

communities.name: Kingston
communities.note: Capital city — the route threads the downtown corridor

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major junction area in central Kingston

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The crossroads of uptown Kingston — 1813 clock tower

communities.name: Arnett Gardens
communities.note: West Kingston community, Spanish Town Road direction

communities.name: Whitfield Town
communities.note: West Kingston, along Spanish Town Road

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: St. Catherine capital, former colonial seat of government

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Entry to the Rio Cobre gorge — Flat Bridge is just ahead

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: St. Catherine market town — famous for the Linstead Market folk song

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: St. Catherine town between Linstead and Moneague

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: St. Ann town at the crossroads — Moneague Lake nearby

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival

communities.name: Lydford
communities.note: St. Ann village on the descent toward Fern Gully

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Three-kilometre ravine canopied by tree ferns — most famous stretch of road in Jamaica

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: St. Ann tourist capital — journey's end at Dunn's River Falls
